name: Time
overview: Scripture reveals that time is a divinely established framework marked by God's creative acts and sovereign control, beginning with the creation of the heavens and the earth (Genesis 1:1). God instituted celestial bodies to separate day from night and to signal seasons and years (Genesis 1:14), demonstrating that time serves His purposes. The detailed chronology surrounding the flood (Genesis 7:11; 8:3, 13) and the prophetic promise of a 400-year period of affliction (Genesis 15:13) affirm that God ordains specific appointed seasons and epochs. Thus, all events unfold according to God's perfect timing and predetermined plan.
